title: sphaeralcea grossulariifolia var. pedata
intro: Sphaeralcea grossulariifolia var. pedata, commonly known as the desert marigold, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of desert marigold include its antiseptic and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating skin conditions and reducing muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Sphaeralcea grossulariifolia var. pedata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
